rules.css: :root { --font-ui: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif; --font-brand: "Noto Serif CJK SC","Songti SC",STSong,serif; --paper: #fffaf0; --paper-strong: #f4ead4; --paper-muted: #f8f0df; --ink: #382c21; --muted: #786650; --line: #e1d1b5; --brand: #8d402c; --brand-hover: #713121; --gold: #e2c38a; --green: #2c6250; --green-bg: #e6eee1; --amber: #865816; --amber-bg: #f4e8cc; --red: #943e30; --red-bg: #f6e5dc; --radius: 8px; --base-size: 15px; --body-height: 1.65; --header: #302116; }
body { background: rgb(32, 24, 16); color: var(--ink); font: var(--base-size)/var(--body-height) var(--font-ui); }
button, input, textarea, select { font: inherit; }

button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: inherit; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.45; }
button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, [tabindex]:focus-visible { outline: rgb(193, 139, 71) solid 3px; outline-offset: 3px; }
button.primary { background: var(--brand); border-color: var(--brand); color: rgb(255, 250, 240); }
button.text-button { padding: 6px 4px; border-color: transparent; color: var(--brand); }
button.icon-button { width: 40px; height: 40px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0px; background: transparent; border-color: transparent; border-radius: 50%; }
.var-icon--set { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1; display: inline-block; flex: 0 0 auto; }
h1, h2, h3, h4, p { margin: 0px; }
.row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.divider { border-right: 0px; border-bottom: 0px; border-left: 0px; border-image: initial; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); margin: 20px 0px; }
#app { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100dvh; overflow: hidden; }
#map-stage { position: absolute; inset: 0px; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; background: rgb(35, 28, 19); outline: none; cursor: grab; }
#map-world { position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 0px; width: 1440px; height: 880px; transform-origin: 0px 0px; will-change: transform; user-select: none; }
.map-image { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }

.map-hud { position: absolute; top: max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-top)); left: max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-left)); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(165, 135, 83, 0.36); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(39, 31, 23, 0.92); color: rgb(240, 223, 189); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.333) 0px 3px 18px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }
.map-hud button { border: 0px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.047); color: rgb(240, 223, 189); padding: 0px; min-height: 38px; width: 38px; border-radius: 7px; position: relative; }
.map-hud .hud-brand { width: auto; min-width: 66px; background: transparent; padding: 0px 3px; font: 600 19px/1 var(--font-brand); letter-spacing: 1px; }
.map-hud .hud-account { padding: 0px; width: 34px; height: 34px; min-height: 34px; background: transparent; margin: 0px 2px; }
.hud-account img { width: 32px; height: 32px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgb(200, 169, 103); }
.unread-dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; background: rgb(234, 201, 129); position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 7px; border-radius: 50%; }

.map-demo-marker { position: absolute; top: 22px; right: 22px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 11px; color: rgb(234, 219, 193); text-shadow: rgb(0, 0, 0) 0px 1px 4px; letter-spacing: 1px; pointer-events: none; }
.map-caption { position: absolute; bottom: 22px; left: 24px; color: rgb(241, 223, 184); text-shadow: rgb(0, 0, 0) 0px 2px 8px; pointer-events: none; display: grid; gap: 4px; }

.landmark { position: absolute; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: rgba(44, 33, 26, 0.918); color: rgb(242, 223, 181); border: 1px solid rgba(179, 148, 92, 0.61); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.333) 0px 3px 12px; min-height: 40px; font: 500 15px/1.4 var(--font-brand); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 5px; gap: 7px; white-space: nowrap; }

.landmark span { display: none; font: 12px var(--font-ui); position: absolute; top: 100%; padding: 5px 8px; margin-top: 5px; background: rgba(38, 27, 19, 0.91); border: 1px solid rgb(167, 135, 82); color: rgb(230, 212, 184); border-radius: 3px; }
.landmark:hover, .landmark:focus-visible { color: rgb(255, 241, 204); background: rgb(81, 58, 35) !important; border-color: rgb(232, 198, 133) !important; }

.agent-hit { position: absolute; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 52px; height: 64px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 50%; padding: 0px; background: transparent; min-height: 44px; }
.agent-hit:hover { box-shadow: rgba(230, 193, 107, 0.4) 0px 0px 16px; border-color: rgb(230, 193, 107) !important; background: rgba(198, 167, 102, 0.082) !important; }

.agent-hit span { display: none; position: absolute; bottom: 100%; padding: 5px 8px; white-space: nowrap; background: rgba(38, 27, 19, 0.91); color: rgb(244, 223, 185); font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(185, 155, 108); border-radius: 4px; }

.return-hall { position: absolute; right: 20px; bottom: 20px; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 22px; background: rgb(242, 230, 199); color: rgb(72, 55, 34); border: 1px solid rgb(217, 193, 141); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.267) 0px 2px 10px; }

.portrait-hint { display: none; position: absolute; bottom: 24px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); white-space: nowrap; color: rgb(244, 230, 199); background: rgba(49, 35, 24, 0.925); border: 1px solid rgb(170, 136, 91); min-height: 44px; }
#business-shell { height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: rgb(39, 27, 17); overflow: hidden; }

.business-header { min-height: 76px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--header); color: rgb(240, 223, 189); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(116, 90, 49); }

.business-brand { display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: flex-start; background: transparent; border: 0px; text-align: left; font: 500 23px/1.4 var(--font-brand); padding: 0px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.brand-seal { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 46px; background: var(--brand); border: 1px solid rgb(184, 121, 80); color: rgb(245, 231, 204); font-size: 25px; }
.business-brand small { display: block; font: 12px/1.6 var(--font-ui); color: rgb(205, 185, 137); letter-spacing: 0px; }
.main-nav button { border: 0px; border-radius: 0px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 15px; color: rgb(238, 221, 185); }

.business-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 8px 24px; min-height: 54px; color: rgb(216, 193, 150); background: rgb(41, 28, 17); font-size: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(108, 80, 43); }
.mode-tabs button { min-height: 34px; border-color: rgb(130, 98, 54); border-radius: 0px; font-size: 13px; padding: 7px 12px; }
.toolbar-actions button { min-height: 32px; font-size: 12px; padding: 5px 10px; border-color: rgb(116, 90, 49); }
#overview { flex: 1 1 0%; overflow: auto; width: min(1250px, 100%); margin: auto; background: var(--paper); padding: 36px clamp(20px, 6vw, 86px); scrollbar-color: rgb(188, 159, 118) transparent; }
.overview-hero { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding-bottom: 28px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.overview-hero h1 { font-family: var(--font-brand); font-size: 28px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
.overview-hero p { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 15px; max-width: 660px; color: var(--muted); }

.overview-map { width: 218px; min-height: 132px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(29, 19, 11, 0.91), rgba(29, 19, 11, 0.063)), url("assets/hall-scene.webp") center center / cover; color: rgb(238, 218, 173); border-color: rgb(147, 115, 69); font-size: 14px; }
.overview-map:hover { background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(29, 19, 11, 0.973), rgba(29, 19, 11, 0.125)), url("assets/hall-scene.webp") center center / cover !important; }
.overview-map strong { font-family: var(--font-brand); font-weight: 500; font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: 8px; }
.list-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin: 24px 0px 6px; }
.tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tabs button { border: 0px; border-radius: 0px; background: transparent; padding: 12px 14px; min-height: 44px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }
.task-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 19px 0px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.task-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; margin-bottom: 7px; line-height: 1.55; }
.task-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
.task-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex: 0 0 auto; }

.status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 8px; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-bg); font-weight: 500; }
.status::before { content: ""; width: 5px; height: 5px; background: currentcolor; border-radius: 50%; }

dialog { padding: 0px; border: 1px solid rgb(201, 177, 138); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: rgba(18, 12, 8, 0.36) 0px 22px 90px; width: min(1000px, -64px + 100vw); max-width: none; max-height: calc(-64px + 100dvh); overflow: hidden; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); }

dialog[data-panel="demand"], dialog[data-panel="confirm"], dialog[data-panel="account"], dialog[data-panel="settings"], dialog[data-panel="login"], dialog[data-panel="guide"] { width: min(720px, -64px + 100vw); }

.panel-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 18px 24px; background: var(--paper-strong); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.panel-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0px; }
.panel-body { padding: 24px; overflow: auto; min-height: 0px; overscroll-behavior: contain; scrollbar-color: rgb(190, 165, 126) transparent; }
.panel-footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 16px 24px; background: var(--paper); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.notice { background: rgb(242, 233, 216); color: rgb(112, 85, 53); padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; border-left: 3px solid rgb(189, 151, 92); }
.notice.success { border-color: var(--green); color: var(--green); background: var(--green-bg); }
.notice.error { border-color: var(--red); background: var(--red-bg); color: var(--red); }
.field-label { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }

input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]), textarea, select { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(203, 185, 154); border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(255, 253, 248); color: var(--ink); font-size: 16px; }
input::placeholder, textarea::placeholder { color: rgb(138, 123, 102); font-size: 14px; opacity: 1; }
input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"] { accent-color: var(--brand); width: 17px; height: 17px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.field-help { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 6px; }
.steps { display: flex; gap: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 24px; padding-bottom: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
.steps span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.steps b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 23px; height: 23px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(232, 222, 200); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }
.upload-block { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 13px; border: 1px dashed rgb(199, 176, 139); border-radius: 6px; }
.attachment-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; background: rgb(246, 236, 217); font-size: 13px; }
.check-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 0px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; }
.filter-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.segmented button { background: rgb(240, 227, 201); border-color: transparent; min-height: 36px; font-size: 13px; padding: 7px 12px; }
.bounty-card p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); margin: 10px 0px; line-height: 1.7; }
.card-meta { display: flex; gap: 14px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.agent-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 1.4fr) minmax(250px, 1fr); gap: 24px; margin-top: 20px; align-items: start; }
.agent-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 12px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid transparent; background: rgb(245, 236, 216); border-radius: 7px; }
.portrait { width: 44px; height: 44px; object-fit: cover; border: 1px solid rgb(183, 166, 129); border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(221, 205, 177); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.agent-info small { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.6; }
.agent-detail { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(255, 249, 236); }
.agent-detail p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.8; margin-top: 12px; }
.tag { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px 8px; background: rgb(238, 228, 205); font-size: 12px; border-radius: 4px; margin: 0px 4px 4px 0px; }
.definition { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 90px minmax(0px, 1fr); gap: 13px; font-size: 14px; margin: 0px; }
.task-detail-title { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.timeline { border-left: 1px solid rgb(205, 187, 154); margin: 22px 0px 22px 8px; padding-left: 24px; list-style: none; }

.timeline li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -29px; top: 7px; width: 9px; height: 9px; background: rgb(72, 115, 78); border: 2px solid var(--paper); box-shadow: rgb(155, 172, 135) 0px 0px 0px 1px; border-radius: 50%; }
.timeline li small { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 4px; }
.chat-layout { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0px; flex: 1 1 0%; }
.chat-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; padding-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.chat-stream { flex: 1 1 0%; overflow: auto; min-height: 200px; padding: 22px 0px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; }
.chat-message { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; max-width: 90%; }

.chat-bubble { background: rgb(240, 230, 208); border: 1px solid rgb(226, 213, 189); border-radius: 0px 8px 8px; padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.file-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-top: 18px; }
.file-card { border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 16px; border-radius: 7px; background: rgb(255, 253, 246); min-width: 0px; }
.file-card .file-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; }
.reader { max-width: 680px; margin: auto; padding: 12px 0px 30px; line-height: 1.9; font-size: 16px; }

.doc-row { width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 14px; text-align: left; border-top: 0px; border-right: 0px; border-left: 0px; border-image: initial; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0px; padding: 18px 0px; }
.quick-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.quick-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgb(255, 249, 234); min-height: 108px; }
.setting-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 16px 0px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 14px; }
.setting-row small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--muted); max-width: 370px; }
.notification { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; padding: 16px; }

.toast { position: fixed; z-index: 10000; bottom: max(28px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); max-width: min(600px, -32px + 100vw); background: rgba(50, 37, 25, 0.96); color: rgb(255, 241, 215); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.267) 0px 4px 22px; border: 1px solid rgb(151, 120, 76); padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; pointer-events: none; }
.login-other { margin: 22px 0px; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }

.document-preview { padding: 24px; background: rgb(255, 253, 250); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: rgba(83, 61, 24, 0.063) 0px 3px 12px; max-width: 680px; margin: auto; }
.responsive-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); text-align: right; margin-top: 18px; }
button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, [tabindex]:focus-visible { outline-color: rgba(146, 63, 48, 0.5); }
#business-shell { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 216px minmax(0px, 1fr); background: var(--paper-strong); }
.sidebar { background: var(--paper); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0px; padding: 28px 15px 16px; overflow: auto; }
.work-brand { border: 0px; padding: 0px 10px; gap: 12px; justify-content: flex-start; text-align: left; flex: 0 0 auto; font: 600 22px/1.4 var(--font-brand); letter-spacing: 2px; }
.brand-seal { background: var(--brand); border: 1px solid rgb(172, 101, 85); color: rgb(255, 247, 233); width: 38px; height: 40px; font: 500 25px/1 var(--font-brand); border-radius: 6px; }
.work-brand small { display: block; font: 12px/1.8 var(--font-ui); letter-spacing: 0px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 4px; }

.side-nav button { border: 1px solid transparent; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 14px; color: rgb(83, 96, 87); font-size: 14px; text-align: left; }
.side-nav button.active { background: rgb(243, 233, 227); color: var(--brand); font-weight: 600; }
.side-nav button.active::after { content: ""; width: 5px; height: 5px; background: var(--brand); border-radius: 50%; margin-left: auto; }
.sidebar-map { display: flex; width: 100%; text-align: left; border-color: var(--line); padding: 13px 10px; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 16px; background: var(--paper-strong); }
.sidebar-map small { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; margin-top: 4px; }

.sidebar-account { border-right: 0px; border-bottom: 0px; border-left: 0px; border-image: initial; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0px; width: 100%; padding: 18px 5px 0px; margin-top: 18px; justify-content: flex-start; text-align: left; gap: 9px; }
.sidebar-account small { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 4px; }
.work-area { min-width: 0px; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

.work-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 76px; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 36px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--paper); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.breadcrumb { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
.demo-badge { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--muted); }
.demo-badge > span { width: 5px; height: 5px; background: var(--green); border-radius: 50%; }
.work-header .unread-dot { background: var(--brand); width: 6px; height: 6px; right: 9px; top: 8px; }
#work-main { flex: 1 1 0%; min-height: 0px; min-width: 0px; overflow: auto; scrollbar-color: rgb(201, 205, 194) transparent; outline: none; padding: 30px 36px 24px; }
#overview { width: 100%; max-width: 1320px; padding: 0px; background: transparent; margin: 0px auto; overflow: visible; }
.work-footnote { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 36px 14px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; flex: 0 0 auto; }

.start-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; padding: 26px 28px; margin-bottom: 26px; background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }

.start-mark { width: 64px; height: 72px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgb(246, 238, 231); border: 1px solid rgb(238, 223, 210); color: rgb(163, 103, 79); font: 400 35px var(--font-brand); border-radius: 30px 30px 9px 9px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.start-steps { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); padding-left: 10px; }
.start-steps span { display: grid; gap: 8px; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; }
.overview-columns { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 1fr) 300px; gap: 24px; align-items: start; }
.work-card { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--paper); border-radius: 11px; min-width: 0px; }
.section-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.tabs { gap: 10px; flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; }
.tabs button { white-space: nowrap; font-size: 13px; padding: 12px 8px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.tabs .count { background: rgb(240, 232, 222); color: var(--brand); font-size: 11px; margin-left: 3px; padding: 1px 5px; }
.task-actions button { font-size: 12px; border-color: transparent; color: var(--muted); padding: 8px 0px 8px 8px; min-height: 36px; }
.card-bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 9px 0px; gap: 12px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.resource-strip { padding: 19px 22px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
.resource-icon { width: 38px; height: 42px; background: rgb(239, 241, 232); display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--green); }
.attention-item { display: flex; gap: 9px; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; width: 100%; padding: 13px 0px; border: 0px; border-radius: 0px; text-align: left; }
.attention-item strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; display: block; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.attention-item small { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 5px; font-weight: 400; }
.attention-dot { height: 6px; width: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--amber); align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 6px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.compact-agent { width: 100%; display: flex; gap: 10px; border: 0px; text-align: left; padding: 11px 0px; justify-content: flex-start; }
.compact-agent small { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; margin-left: 8px; }
.compact-agent em { font-style: normal; display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 5px; }

.map-entry { height: 176px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; padding: 0px; border-radius: 11px; border: 1px solid rgb(202, 199, 181); text-align: left; display: block; width: 100%; color: rgb(255, 249, 233); }
.map-entry > img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center 53%; transition: transform 0.3s; }

.map-entry-copy { position: absolute; inset: 0px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; padding: 22px 18px 16px; background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(33, 27, 19, 0.91), transparent 100%); }
.map-entry strong { display: block; font-size: 15px; font-family: var(--font-brand); font-weight: 500; }
.map-entry small { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: rgb(232, 223, 205); margin-top: 6px; font-weight: 400; }
.page-surface { background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; }
#page-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 18px 26px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.board-list .task-actions button { border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 13px; }
input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]), textarea, select { background: var(--paper); border-color: rgb(204, 210, 197); }
.notice { background: rgb(242, 242, 234); border-color: rgb(178, 187, 158); color: rgb(93, 102, 89); }
dialog { border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: rgba(36, 46, 43, 0.16) 0px 26px 90px; }
.toast { background: rgba(41, 55, 47, 0.96); color: rgb(255, 254, 250); border: 1px solid rgb(83, 97, 87); }
#page-view[data-page="chat"] .page-surface { height: calc(-258px + 100dvh); min-height: 440px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.chat-sessions { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow: auto; flex: 0 0 auto; margin: -4px 0px 22px; padding-bottom: 8px; }
.chat-sessions button { white-space: nowrap; flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 13px; min-height: 38px; background: var(--paper-strong); border-color: transparent; }
.chat-sessions button.active { background: rgb(234, 240, 230); color: var(--green); border-color: rgb(188, 205, 180); }
#page-view[data-page="chat"] { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 0px; max-width: none; margin: 0px; }
#page-view[data-page="chat"] > .page-heading { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; }
#page-view[data-page="chat"] .page-surface { flex: 1 1 0%; height: auto; min-height: 0px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.chat-toolbar h3 { font-size: 16px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.chat-context-chip { display: block; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.chat-composer { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 1fr) auto; grid-template-rows: auto auto; gap: 6px 10px; }
.chat-composer textarea { grid-area: 1 / 1; height: 52px; min-height: 48px; max-height: 112px; margin: 0px; padding: 12px; line-height: 1.6; }
.chat-composer button[type="submit"] { grid-area: 1 / 2; align-self: end; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 16px; }
.chat-composer #chat-counter { grid-area: 2 / 1 / auto / -1; font-size: 11px; max-width: none; line-height: 1.5; }
